title: Livestock Treatment Inspection Checklist Form
subtitle: Livestock Treatment prepare the inspection, examine domain-specific conditions, record findings, assign corrections, decide status, and close the review.
description: An original, workflow-complete livestock treatment inspection checklist covering identity and routing, domain observations and evidence, accountable decisions, exceptions and escalation, and completion handoff without replacing qualified judgment.
use_case: Use for a planned or triggered inspection that must preserve observed condition, finding severity, correction ownership, and an authorized disposition. The record is owned by the herd or flock health owner and closes only after evidence, exceptions, disposition, and the next accountable handoff are documented.

sections.title: Livestock Treatment inspection routing
sections.guidance: Identify the inspection, subject, inspector, and review route.

blocks.label: Inspection Checklist identity and routing
blocks.guidance: Assign one owner and use the same record ID in attachments and follow-up.

blocks.label: Animal Treatment Event identity
blocks.guidance: Preserve the identifiers used by the controlling farm, facility, or partner record.

sections.title: Livestock Treatment inspection preparation
sections.guidance: Record conditions and evidence sources before making findings.

blocks.label: Preparation and prior-record review
items: Animal or group identity and count were verified
Condition and qualified authorization reference were recorded
Product name, lot, expiry, dose, route, and duration were captured
Person administering and treatment date and time were captured
Meat, milk, egg, or other hold instructions were recorded if applicable
Withdrawal or discard end date was calculated by authorized instruction
Response, adverse event, and follow-up observations were routed
Inventory use and permanent animal record were reconciled

blocks.label: Livestock Treatment inspection points
items: Animal or group identity matches the treatment record
Condition and authorization or protocol reference are present
Product identity, lot, expiry, and storage record were reviewed
Dose, route, interval, and duration match controlling instructions
Administration site and person were documented
Treatment response and follow-up observations were recorded
Adverse event, missed dose, or treatment failure was escalated
Meat, milk, egg, or other hold status is visible when applicable
Withdrawal or discard end point is linked to authorized direction
Inventory, disposal, and permanent record entries reconcile

sections.title: Livestock Treatment determination and correction
sections.guidance: Assign the condition decision and every required correction.

sections.title: Livestock Treatment exceptions and escalation
sections.guidance: Escalate uncertainty and conditions outside the reviewer’s authority.

blocks.label: Inspection authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This record does not diagnose, prescribe, set a dose, or release an animal or food product. Follow current veterinary or authorized instructions and applicable requirements. Hold and escalate any identity, treatment, adverse response, withdrawal, discard, or release uncertainty.

blocks.label: Livestock Treatment exception triggers
items: Animal or group identity is uncertain
Authorization, protocol, label, or prescription is missing
Product, lot, expiry, dose, route, or time discrepancy
Adverse response, missed dose, or treatment failure
Withdrawal, discard, or food-product hold is uncertain
Inventory, storage, administration, or record mismatch

blocks.label: Escalation facts, immediate action, owner, due point, and disposition

sections.title: Livestock Treatment inspection closeout
sections.guidance: Confirm correction ownership and transfer the inspection record.

blocks.label: Livestock Treatment open actions and limitations
blocks.guidance: Carry forward every item that is not fully resolved at closeout.

blocks.label: Livestock Treatment handoff confirmations
items: Livestock Treatment findings and evidence were reconciled
Restrictions or holds were transferred to operations
Corrections and verification have owners and due points
Reinspection or follow-up review was scheduled
Inspection evidence and disposition were filed
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items remain part of the open handoff.

blocks.label: Final outcome, remaining limits, communications, and acceptance notes
